opportunities.rationale: Amazon AI deal, SK Hynix-Intel US chip talks, Waymo expansion signal multi-year AI capex supercycle; Fed hike supports risk appetite

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce EM fund exposure; avoid Turkey-linked and small-cap EM vehicles
defensive_moves.rationale: $4B fund rout signals liquidity crisis; contagion risk to other EM funds; FX calm masks underlying fragility

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk with short-duration bonds or T-bills; avoid long-duration exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Fed hiking cycle just started; PE industry and leveraged borrowers face refinancing stress; basis trade may be unwinding

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain 10-15% gold allocation as geopolitical hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: Russia-NATO tensions, Iran war, Hormuz crisis create tail risk; gold stable post-Fed but geopolitical premium intact

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid high-leverage PE-backed companies and data-center-heavy utilities
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate rise exacerbates PE debt costs; data center energy bills rising; House bill may cap utility pricing but adds regulatory uncertainty

defensive_moves.recommendation: Lock in 2-year CDs at 4.40% APY for cash parking
defensive_moves.rationale: Fed hike cycle supports higher short-term yields; CD rates attractive vs. equity volatility

market_outlook.short_term: Markets constructive post-Fed hike; tech leads, oil volatile near $100. Turkey crisis contained but EM sentiment fragile. Yen weak, USD strong. Crypto choppy on CLARITY failure. 1-3 month: range-bound with upside bias if oil stabilizes and AI capex narrative holds.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month: Fed hiking cycle pressures PE leverage and EM debt; AI capex supercycle supports tech earnings; oil normalization benefits transport/consumer; geopolitical risk (Russia-NATO, Iran) is primary tail risk. US wealth concentration and consumer squeeze create political volatility. India and select EMs outperform.
